primary_risk: Dependence on the Hard Disk Drive (HDD) market
sector_survival_note: The HDD market is expected to decline, but Seagate's transition to solid-state drives (SSDs) and other emerging technologies may help it survive.
thesis_summary: Seagate Technology Holdings plc, a leading manufacturer of hard disk drives, solid-state drives, and other data storage solutions, rides the trend of increasing data storage needs and leverages its scale and brand to maintain its competitive advantage.
thesis_breaks_if: Short-term price moves, news cycles, and 8-K noise, unless they structurally change the next decade.
sentiment_note: Accumulate slowly due to rich valuation.
ten_k_highlights: Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a leading manufacturer of hard disk drives, solid-state drives, and other data storage solutions.
The company's revenue has been falling over the past five years, but its gross margin has been increasing.
Seagate has a strong track record of capital allocation, with a 35.6% increase in return on invested capital over the past five years.
valuation_note: FCF yield 1.3%, PEG 0.6, EV/EBITDA 58 — priced ahead of fundamentals — accumulate slowly.
